_help: Leave this file as it is unless 01_inspect_data.py tells you a column was mapped wrongly. Delete the lines starting with _ if you like.
_example_sensors: To fix a column: add  "sensors": {"T1": "temp_top", "T2": "temp_middle", "H1": "hum_middle"}  (names must start with temp_ or hum_)
_example_time: If the date/time column is not found: add  "datetime": "ColumnName"   or   "date": "DateCol", "time": "TimeCol"
